title: Brock Commons Tallwood House
jurisdiction: University of British Columbia, Vancouver, British Columbia
code_edition: British Columbia Building Code 2012; UBC Tall Wood Building Regulation (September 2015), project-specific
document_date: 2017 overview; supporting operational report dated September 2020

facts.text: The project overview identifies an 18-storey, 54 m residential building with Group A-2 assembly spaces and states that the proposal exceeded the prescriptive BCBC 2012 combustible-construction limits.
It describes a project-specific UBC Tall Wood Building Regulation drafted with the BC Building and Safety Standards Branch in September 2015.
The overview describes 2-hour encapsulated structural elements, suite/corridor separations, sprinklers, standpipe, water curtain, and backup fire-water measures.
UBC's operational report records CLT moisture and building vertical movement monitoring during early occupancy.
facts.locator: Operational Performance of Cross Laminated Timber, PDF pp.3, 15

limitations: The overview is a project-team case document, not the permit file or a complete alternative-solution report.

The 2020 operational report is monitoring evidence, not fire-resistance or equivalency evidence; its download metadata reports a curl timeout, although the saved file has the expected 29,734,480 bytes and parses as a 16-page PDF.
